dimensions.assessment: Affects owners and operators of gas distribution pipeline facilities across the country.
dimensions.evidence: each owner or operator of a gas distribution pipeline facility shall assess its system for the presence of Aldyl-A polyethylene.

dimensions.assessment: Requires system assessments and reporting of pipeline mileage without mandating new excavation activities for the assessment.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall not require owners and operators of gas distribution pipeline facilities to conduct excavation activities for the purpose of the assessment

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative compliance costs for pipeline operators to assess and report, but states no specific federal spending amounts.
Amends federal pipeline safety statutes to include historic plastics with known safety issues in state program certifications and distribution integrity management programs.
dimensions.evidence: pipelines constructed of historic plastics with known safety issues

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a 3-year deadline for assessments and reporting, alongside permanent statutory changes to pipeline safety programs.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 3 years after the date of enactment of this Act, each owner or operator... shall assess its system

missing_information: The exact number of pipeline facilities or total mileage of Aldyl-A piping currently in service is not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates that gas distribution pipeline facility owners and operators assess their systems for Aldyl-A polyethylene piping and report mileage estimates within 3 years, while updating safety programs.

card.label: S. 2975
card.summary: The PIPELINE Safety Act of 2025 amends federal laws regarding pipeline safety, reauthorizes funding for the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration and related programs through fiscal year 2030, and establishes new requirements and programs related to pipeline inspections, emerging gases, environmental and geological hazards, stakeholder engagement, and emergency response.
